# Stochastic parrot

![parrot](../images/papagaio_alex.jpg)

::: notes
- By virtue of their architecture and training method, large language models (LLMs) that underly GenAI chatbots, mimic observed patterns in their input and generate these patterns probabilistically [@bender] 
- This is why they've been referred to as *stochastic parrots*
